frontier.hypothesis: loop.c:1609 `if (moved_once[regno]) insn_count *= 2;` is the cheapest untried route: doubling insn_count 62 -> 124 makes the loop.c:1631 test 122 >= 124 fail, so 0x91A2B3C5 stays in the loop with no call and no padding, and the margin needed is only 2.
